Speechless, teeth grinding, groaning: I managed all three together.
No practice for a performance. Came naturally.

The besiegers' retreat should finally have given me a chance to enter.
No, I had actually stepped inside once.

Immediately pushed out again.

No staying in a castle turned into a district of madness, a forest of swords and rain of bullets flying everywhere.

en.html:
I knew what was happening. Understood it better than the people turned into rioters.
The Silver Star had appeared and begun contamination. No other explanation.

But why was Hikaru Minato—the Silver Star—here at Fudaraku, when she should have been in Izu Horigoe?
Had Chachamaru Ashikaga brought her?

Then for what purpose?
What did she gain by releasing destruction and slaughter inside this castle—?

Kanae"Then, a message, please. —The occupation forces will use their decisive weapon, the forged thunder bomb."

Kanae"Message complete. Understood?"

Muramasa"?"
Kanae"Attach it to this arrow."
